title: Offline quality build encountered font access and disk-space failures
summary: First build was blocked by font-download access; the next exhausted disk space. Only this task’s failed webpack cache was removed. A cache-disabled isolated retry is pending.

changes.detail: Disabled webpack disk caching only in the new disposable build-check configuration after ENOSPC. Root application configuration and all older releases/backups are unchanged. Removed only .next/cache inside this task’s explicitly resolved build directory.
